medium: Stage 5 state is still in_progress and its attached review run remains at iteration 3 with the previous FAIL recorded; the implementation may satisfy the criteria, but the canonical stage state has not been reconciled with the repaired code.
The Stage Manager is a state tracker, not an unattended multi-run queue/executor as claimed by the Stage 5 acceptance criterion and the README's description of autonomous stage progression.

audit-all validates expected IDs and axis scores but does not reject duplicate records, unexpected game IDs, or missing non-score audit fields, so structurally incomplete batch data can still reach the canonical merged audit.
improve accepts an unregistered gameType, falls back to src/q1/<Component>.tsx, and creates a misleading project/run instead of rejecting the unknown identifier.
low: loop.mjs does not validate --max-iterations as a positive integer.
research uses date-only request filenames, so multiple research invocations on the same day overwrite the earlier prompt and result.
codex-task.mjs treats a nonzero Codex exit as successful when a parseable final message exists; JSON validity is checked, but process failure is not preserved in that case.
The Codex adapters leave their temporary directories behind.
